name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1927: Two follow-ons to the constant-returning bar reader, both found by measuring coverage instead of stopping at it works now. First: is_gold required blue under 130 and the bar own pixels reach 131, so the contiguous run was cut one pixel short on his sets panel, the track walk then ended BEHIND the gold, the fraction came out just over 1 and the reader refused every frame - zero of twenty five. The warm versus grey split is already done by red minus blue over 35, where bar pixels measure 42 to 61 and the dark track beyond measures minus 4 to zero, so the blue cap was redundant and load bearing in the wrong direction. It now answers on 22 of 25 and reads 84.4 percent where the game prints 85, and 61.4 where the game prints 63 - two reels returning two different numbers, which is the property the old reader did not have. Second, and more uncomfortable: the 3 point tolerance is ABOVE the defect it exists to catch. His board read 87.4 percent against a printed 85, a 2.4 point gap, inside the tolerance, verdict agree. It is deliberately not tightened because the reader is only good to about two points itself and a gate that fires on its own noise is a gate nobody reads. The exact instrument for a small gap is the counter ledger, which reads the game own Remaining page and names the rows. Both are kept and the limit is recorded as a test rather than left as a surprise.
